<template id="tpl-explorer">
  <fieldset class="toolbar">
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">File</a>
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">Edit</a>
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">View</a>
    <a class="toolbar-link" href="#">Help</a>
  </fieldset>
  <div class="explorer-panes">
    <div class="explorer-tree-pane">
      <ul class="tree-view" style="height: 100%; overflow-y: auto;">
        <li>
          <details open>
            <summary data-folder=""><img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/computer_2_cool-1.png" alt=""> C:/</summary>
            <ul>
              <li>
                <summary data-folder="home" data-window="home">About Me</summary>
              </li>
              <li>
                <details>
                  <summary data-folder="projects" data-window="projects">Projects</summary>
                  <ul id="explorer-projects-tree"></ul>
                </details>
              </li>
              <li>
                <details>
                  <summary data-folder="publications" data-window="publications">Publications</summary>
                  <ul id="explorer-publications-tree"></ul>
                </details>
              </li>
              <li>
                <details>
                  <summary data-folder="music" data-window="music">Music</summary>
                </details>
              </li>
              <li>
                <details>
                  <summary data-folder="utilities" data-window="utilities">Utilities</summary>
                  <ul>
                    <li data-window="mandelbrot">Mandelbrot</li>
                    <li data-window="harmonograph">Harmonograph</li>
                    <li data-window="image-to-ascii">Image to ASCII</li>
                    <li data-window="bmg-format">BMG Format</li>
                    <li data-window="l5r-dice">L5R Dice</li>
                  </ul>
                </details>
              </li>
              <li>
                <details>
                  <summary data-folder="resume" data-window="resume">Resume</summary>
                </details>
              </li>    
            </ul>        
          </details>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="explorer-content-pane">
      <ul class="file-explorer" id="explorer-content"></ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
